name: Telegram Notification 0.4.1
description: Send recording info, cover image and video to Telegram via MTProto (supports files over 50 MB and HTTP/SOCKS5 proxies). Can create/reuse one group forum topic per model and post the video into it. Uses your signed-in account by default: it can list existing topics (no duplicates) and premium accounts can upload single files up to 4 GB

account.label: Login mode (auto = your signed-in account wins / user = your account only / bot = bot account only)

api_hash.label: API Hash (bot accounts only — leave empty for a user account)

chat_id.label: Chat ID (groups and supergroups: -100xxxxxxxxxx; a private group has no username, so the id is the only way to target it)

username.label: Group username (optional — public groups only, e.g. mygroupname, without @; leave empty for private groups and use Chat ID)

topic_per_model.label: Create/reuse a group topic per model and upload into it
